title: Apply a discount to a cart subtotal
summary: A small online shop is adding a percentage promotion to its checkout. Given the cart's line items and a discount percentage, calculate the pre-discount subtotal, the amount taken off, and the amount the customer pays. Keep all monetary values in cents so the result does not depend on floating-point currency formatting.
requirements: Each line item has a quantity and a unit price in cents. The subtotal is the sum of quantity multiplied by unitCents for every line item.
Apply discountPercent to the subtotal. discountPercent is a number from 0 to 100 inclusive; 0 leaves the subtotal unchanged and 100 makes the total zero.
Round the discounted total once to the nearest whole cent using Math.round. Set discountCents to subtotalCents minus totalCents so the returned amounts always reconcile.
Return an object with subtotalCents, discountCents, and totalCents. An empty cart returns zero for all three amounts.
hints: Round the discounted total once; the difference is the discount amount.
